items.question: By what count and in what locations are certain beings said to endure torment in this claim?
premises: A count of eighty-four is specified here.
That count applies to thousands of locations.
Those locations are identified as womb-diagrams.
Beings in those locations are said to be tormented.
items.inference: Torment is ascribed to beings situated in eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams.
uncertainties: The identity of the tormented beings remains unspecified.
The cause of torment is not stated here.
items.plain_english: Eighty-four thousand womb-diagrams are places where beings are tormented.
